description: Deprecated statements associating pembrolizumab monotherapy with esophageal adenocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma of the gastroesophageal junction in favor of a statement for Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (stmt:fda:keytruda:8:2), as this indication is limited to tumors of squamous cell histology.
